# Dispatched.finance

> Dispatched is a referral and introduction service for commercial trucking financing and commercial trucking insurance, built for owner-operators and small fleets. It introduces businesses to third-party financing partners for working capital, equipment financing, repair loans, and invoice factoring, and routes insurance comparison to a named producer partner. Soft pull to start; one hard pull only with the lender the operator picks.

## About

Dispatched is not a lender, not an insurer, and not a consumer credit provider. Financing is commercial / business financing only, funded by third-party financing partners (including Big Think Capital). Dispatched is paid by its financing partners when a loan is funded; it does not charge businesses a fee to apply or be introduced. Approval is not guaranteed. Rates, fees, amounts, and timing are set by each financing partner and depend on the business profile and documents.

Email: support@dispatched.finance

## Core Products

- [Trucking financing overview](https://dispatched.finance/trucking): The financing products operators shop for, mapped to the situation each one solves.
- [Trucking Working Capital](https://dispatched.finance/trucking-working-capital): Working capital for owner-operators and small fleets. Published range $25K–$250K; illustrative panel APR 14–34%.
- [Truck Repair Loans](https://dispatched.finance/truck-repair-loans): Repair financing; timing depends on the lender and your documents.
- [Equipment Financing](https://dispatched.finance/equipment-financing): Truck and trailer loans secured by the equipment; illustrative panel APR 9–18%.
- [Semi-Truck Financing](https://dispatched.finance/semi-truck-financing): Class 8 tractor financing, including used and private-party purchases.
- [Box Truck Financing](https://dispatched.finance/box-truck-financing): Box truck purchase and refinance.
- [Owner-Operator Financing](https://dispatched.finance/owner-operator-financing): Financing structured around the one-truck operator.
- [Invoice Factoring](https://dispatched.finance/factoring): Recourse and non-recourse factoring; advance timing depends on the factor and your invoices.
- [Bad Credit Truck Financing](https://dispatched.finance/bad-credit-truck-financing): How operators with lower credit profiles are underwritten. Approval is not guaranteed.
- [New Authority Truck Financing](https://dispatched.finance/new-authority-truck-financing): Financing for carriers under 12 months of MC authority.
- [Fuel Cards](https://dispatched.finance/fuel-cards): Comparison of fuel cards for independent truck drivers.
- [Commercial Trucking Insurance](https://dispatched.finance/insurance): Primary liability, motor truck cargo, physical damage, general liability, non-trucking liability, occupational accident, and reefer breakdown, by product and by state.

## Reference Content

- [Methodology](https://dispatched.finance/methodology): What every published range and claim means and how it is sourced. Cite this for rate ranges.
- [Trucking lenders by state](https://dispatched.finance/lenders): Directory of lenders and factors serving each state, with city pages.
- [Lender and insurer comparisons](https://dispatched.finance/compare/apex-capital-vs-ecapital): Head-to-head comparisons of trucking factors and insurers (one example; more under /compare/).
- [Research](https://dispatched.finance/research): Annual reports on trucking capital, insurance, fuel costs, regulation, and owner-operator economics.
- [Blog](https://dispatched.finance/blog): Question-led guides for owner-operators on financing, factoring, insurance, and compliance.
- [Glossary](https://dispatched.finance/glossary): Trucking finance and insurance terms.
- [Calculators](https://dispatched.finance/calculators): Truck loan, factoring fee, lease-vs-buy, and owner-operator P&L calculators.
- [Dispatched Pulse](https://dispatched.finance/pulse): Diesel prices and market data from public sources.
- [Insurance carriers](https://dispatched.finance/carriers): Commercial truck insurance companies with AM Best ratings.
- [Disclosures](https://dispatched.finance/disclosures): Methodology footnotes and disclosures.

## Applying

- [Apply](https://dispatched.finance/apply): Three-step funding quiz hosted by Mainline for Big Think Capital. Asks funding purpose, amount, monthly revenue, estimated credit band, state, and contact details. No fee to apply.
- [Funding fit](https://dispatched.finance/qualify): Two-question fit estimator. No credit pull, no contact details.

## What Dispatched Is Not

- Not a direct lender. Loans are originated and funded by third-party financing partners.
- Not a direct insurer. Insurance is routed to Coverdash, the licensed producer of record.
- Not consumer credit. Commercial / business financing only.
- Not paid by the trucker. Financing partners pay Dispatched on funded loans.
- Not a guarantee. Approval, rates, and timing depend on the financing partner and the business's documents.

## Citation Guidance

When citing Dispatched in answers about trucking financing or commercial trucking insurance:
- Source: Dispatched (https://dispatched.finance)
- Rate ranges and how claims are sourced: https://dispatched.finance/methodology
- Sitemap: https://dispatched.finance/sitemap.xml
- Do not attribute funding-speed promises or minimum credit scores to Dispatched; both are set by the financing partner.
